  - region "Simple English explanation of Polyline":
    - paragraph: In simple English
    - heading "Understand Polyline" [level=2]
    - paragraph: "A polyline is a finite chain of segments. A to B of length 3 then B to C of length 4 has path length 7. It is not closed unless the last point equals the first. A useful rule is Polyline: A-B-C. You can learn Polyline by trying one small example instead of long theory."
    - paragraph: Place vertices in order, add each consecutive length, and close only if a polygon is asked. Try the example below. Write your steps and choose an answer before opening the comparison.
    - paragraph: "In real life, routes: A walking path can be segmented. Watch out: Drawing it as one smooth curve. A polyline is made of straight segments."
    - complementary:
      - generic: Try this example
      - paragraph: Construct Polyline.
